components.name: Research introduction
components.description: A static single-column introduction. Instrument Serif title at 56px, DM Sans description at 24px and supporting copy at 18px; phone scale 44/20/16. No result data, right-hand visual or duplicate CTA.
components.html:
EMBERBench

A benchmark for how AI guides people through simulated fire evacuations, where routes can close and queues can form.

At each step, a model sees the current situation and chooses how people move as the fire spreads. It must respond to blocked paths and congestion without knowing where the fire will spread next.

Models are evaluated in the same frozen environments. Each recorded run is replayed and checked before scoring for safety and execution quality. The published results cover the public development suite.

narrative.northStar: The supplied identity, direct access to research.
narrative.overview: Navy identity on a light gradient with an asymmetric curved shore. A single-column EMBERBench introduction explains the task and verified evaluation through a proportionate, readable type hierarchy. Results remain full width on their own page and documentation stays local.
keyCharacteristics: Original navy emblem and local fonts
rules: Do not restore evacuation-grid or replay UI.
Keep published results and scientific qualifications unchanged.
Do not embed comparison tables or comparison selectors on results.
Keep results full width with open chart sections.
Documentation links open local complete guides.
Anantam’s tagline is always Boundless Possibilities. Hero uses pale drifting contours without a darker traveling stroke, on a light mist-blue/porcelain/ivory gradient.
Results begin with only one compact search and a closed Filters disclosure. Avoid duplicate metric/model controls and chart-navigation rows.
Do not add a second benchmark CTA or navigation links inside the homepage contribution.
Methodology has no benchmark sub-navigation or results CTA.
The hero gradient ends in one broad asymmetric shore. Below it, use a single text-led research introduction with no model scores, charts, stock image, feature list or right-hand column.
Scenarios follows the Methodology reading layout: vertical index, open article, expandable matrix/catalogue, no dashboard tabs.
End pages with the shared asymmetric light-gradient company footer, containing supplied branding and real research/resource links.

Benchmark charts compare the entire filtered cohort. Do not feature a default model, paginate the main desktop ranking or replace cohort charts on selection. Use authentic local provider logos and observed brand colours.

Persistent chart rules: vertical columns on every screen; each series highest to lowest; missing values last; crowding handled through measured vertical bands and per-chart zoom, never sideways bars or page scrolling. Scientific rank metadata remains unchanged.
dos: Preserve keyboard, touch and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not add future products or claims.
Do not introduce decorative AI imagery or a dark theme.
